name: 🏙️ Mini City Tycoon
desc:
Welcome! In this game you can build your own mini city, go from nothing to a huge metropolis!

🗺️ Choose from a variety of maps to build your city on
🛣️ Place curved or straight roads, houses, skyscrapers, stores and much more
🚗 Watch AI cars and npcs navigate around your city
⏫ Unlock new buildings as you level up
✈️ Travel to other players cities in the server
🚘 Drive around your city in cool cars

💸 Join the group for a 10% cash boost

💖 Like the game for updates!
